evidence.quote: Nonetheless, inflation remains elevated, and this is the problem that concerns me most.
we have acted boldly to address rising inflation, and we are committed to taking the further steps necessary.
With still-strong labor demand and sluggish labor supply, the job market remains very tight.
Those inflation expectations can become entrenched and, in doing so, increase the likelihood that high inflation will persist.
Restoring price stability may take some time and will likely entail a period of below-trend growth.
